basics.name: Heikki Rautanen
basics.label: Senior Data Engineer, Full Stack Developer and Partner
basics.summary:
Heikki is an experienced IT professional with a diverse background covering roles from data engineer to integration architect. Solution-oriented and curious by nature, he enjoys teamwork and achieving goals together with others. Adaptable and eager to learn, Heikki thrives in environments where problem-solving and continuous learning are part of everyday work.

His current focus is on AI, with a strong belief that AI will play a transformative role in shaping the future. He sees high-quality data as the key for achieving meaningful AI outcomes. He approaches challenges by first understanding the business context and big picture, then identifying the most suitable technologies to deliver results.
basics.x-tagline: Reliable data turned into insight is what makes AI work.

x-strengths.title: Data Engineering
x-strengths.description: Heikki has been crafting end-to-end platforms—ingesting, transforming and modeling data with multiple technologies to deliver reliable, high-quality data.

x-strengths.title: Versatile
x-strengths.description: Experience across a wide range of technologies and roles, adapting quickly to new challenges and project needs.

x-strengths.title: Curious
x-strengths.description: Naturally driven to explore and learn, refining practices through hands-on problem solving and continuous improvement.

x-keyRoles.title: Senior Data Engineer
x-keyRoles.description: Heikki has worked as a senior data engineer across several projects, where he has been involved in architecture design, development and data modeling. He has also been leading data teams.

x-keyRoles.title: Integration Architect
x-keyRoles.description: As an integration architect his responsibilities were leading development teams and driving the design and implementation of scalable integration solutions. He worked closely with stakeholders and technical teams to keep everyone aligned with the business goals.

projects.name: AI pipeline and SaaS development
projects.description: The product (SaaS) is an enterprise platform that collects publicly available company documents, classifies them by sustainability relevance and generates company profiles using Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), ChatGPT and Gemini. Heikki's responsibilities were to create the backend system for the app and help to improve the AI pipeline. He also created new features to the frontend.

projects.name: Data layer performance improvement and data platform
projects.description: Responsible for implementing a more performant data layer using Elasticsearch. Developed a cloud infrastructure as code using Terraform. Led the design and implementation of a data platform leveraging a data lakehouse architecture for storage and reporting. Provided ongoing maintenance for previously developed modern web applications and system integrations.
keywords: Azure (Databricks, Data Lake, Data Factory, Container Service, Functions, Event Bus, SQL)

projects.name: Core migration and data project
projects.description: Responsible for designing and implementing a migration from an old ERP system to a new one. Assisted in preparing data for an AI-driven matching service. Midway through the project, took on primary responsibility, including gathering requirements, leading the development team, and maintaining effective communication with stakeholders.
keywords: AWS (Lambda, Step Functions, RDS, EC2, S3)

projects.name: Customer Analytics Platform
projects.description: Responsible for designing, implementing and maintaining solutions relating to systems responsible for processing and running the client's customer surveys and data platforms.
keywords: Azure (Databricks, SQL, Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, DevOps)

projects.name: Integration Centre of Excellence
projects.description: Working as an integration architect in various projects and value streams. Heikki was responsible for leading development teams, designing and implementing solutions, and working with the client needs. His job was to ensure that client needs were fulfilled, and the targets of the integration projects were exceeded. In addition, his role included participating in the governance and operations of integrations.

projects.name: Integration Centre of Excellence
projects.description: Responsible for development and maintenance of integrations, workflows and APIs using mainly IBM WebSphere DataPower, IBM WebSphere MQ and Automic ONE Automation platforms with XSLT and JavaScript. The responsibilities also included development and maintenance of existing Java applications running on IBM WebSphere Application Server.

projects.name: Live audience participation tool
projects.description: Responsible for project management. In addition, Heikki participated in backend development.
